gloss: person with parental authority; legal guardian (parent)

definitions.gloss: person with parental authority; parent with legal custody of a minor child
definitions.explanation: A legal term referring to the parent or parents who hold {親権|しんけん} (parental authority) over a minor child — the right and duty to care for the child, manage their property, and represent them legally. Especially important after divorce, when one parent is often designated as the sole {親権者|しんけんしゃ}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母親|ははおや}→母親：03564_hahaoya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{親権者|しんけんしゃ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The mother became the parent with legal custody.

examples.japanese: ⟦{離婚|りこん}→離婚：02530_rikon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧、⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{親権者|しんけんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{争|あらそ}った→争う：01866_arasou⟧。
examples.english: When they divorced, they fought over which parent would have legal custody.

examples.japanese: {未成年者|みせいねんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{親権者|しんけんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{同意|どうい}→同意：05092_doui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: A contract with a minor requires the consent of the parent with legal authority.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{親権|しんけん}→親権：14161_shinken⟧ (parental authority) and the suffix {〜者|しゃ} (person). A legal term used in family law and official documents. In Japan, divorcing parents typically cannot share joint custody of a minor child the way they can in many Western countries — one parent is designated as the sole {親権者|しんけんしゃ}, which is often a contentious issue.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {親権者|しんけんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become the parent with legal custody
- {親権者|しんけんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to decide who will have legal custody
- {親権者|しんけんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{同意|どうい}→同意：05092_doui⟧: the consent of the parent with legal authority
- {親権者|しんけんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧: change of legal custody

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{親権|しんけん}→親権：14161_shinken⟧: parental authority (the right itself)
- ⟦{保護者|ほごしゃ}→保護者：11564_hogosha⟧: guardian — broader term that can include legal guardians who are not parents; also used in school contexts
- ⟦{後見人|こうけんにん}→後見人：10676_koukennin⟧: legal guardian — for minors without parents, or for adults who cannot manage their own affairs
- {未成年者|みせいねんしゃ}: minor — the person over whom parental authority is exercised
